About

What Is Nexis?

Nexis is led like an international gaming company, from the board to the studio floor.

  • Shareholders own the company and elect the Board of directors.
  • The Board appoints the CEO and keeps watch through its audit, compensation and risk committees.
  • The CEO leads the whole company and the eight officers below.
  • Game and product side: CCO, CPO, CTO and COO build and run the games.
  • Business and support side: CFO, CMO, CLO and CHRO handle money, brand, law and people.
  • Next level: studio heads, department directors and team leads run the daily work.

          How to Play

          Rules & tips

          • Register with a username — no Gmail needed.
          • The grid has 36 tiles. One hidden tile holds the treasure.
          • You get 5 digs per day. Digs reset every midnight.
          • Finding treasure earns you 50 coins and a win.
          • The treasure location is on the server — no peeking!
          • Climb the Leaderboard by racking up wins across days.
